clauses.quote: Minimum Average Annual Turnover of the bidder (For the last 3 Financial Years) 4 Lakh (s)
clauses.summary: The bidder must have a minimum average annual turnover of Rs 4 lakh over the last three financial years.

clauses.quote: OEM Average Turnover (Last 3 Years) 33 Lakh (s) /Years of Past Experience Required
clauses.summary: The OEM of the offered product must have an average turnover of Rs 33 lakh over the last three years.

clauses.quote: Years of Past Experience Required for same/similar service 2 Year (s)
clauses.summary: The bidder needs 2 years of past experience in same or similar supplies.

clauses.quote: MSE Relaxation for Years Of Experience and Turnover Yes Complete
clauses.summary: MSEs get complete relaxation from experience and turnover criteria.

clauses.quote: Startup Relaxation for Years Of Experience and Turnover Yes Complete
clauses.summary: Startups get complete relaxation from experience and turnover criteria.

clauses.quote: In case any bidder is seeking exemption from Experience / Turnover Criteria, the supporting documents to prove his eligibility for exemption must be uploaded for evaluation by the buyer
clauses.summary: Bidders seeking experience or turnover exemption must upload supporting documents proving eligibility.

clauses.heading: EMD Detail
clauses.quote: EMD Detail M /Advisory Bank HDFC Bank /EMD Amount 17000
clauses.summary: An EMD of Rs 17,000 is required.

clauses.heading: EMD EXEMPTION
clauses.quote: The bidder seeking EMD exemption, must submit the valid supporting document for the relevant category as per GeM GTC with the bid.
clauses.summary: Bidders claiming EMD exemption must submit valid supporting documents for their category with the bid.

clauses.heading: EMD EXEMPTION
clauses.quote: Under MSE category, only manufacturers for goods and Service Providers for Services are eligible for exemption from EMD. Traders are excluded from the purview of this Policy.
clauses.summary: Only MSE manufacturers or service providers, not traders, are eligible for EMD exemption.

clauses.quote: If the bidder is a Micro or Small Enterprise as per latest orders issued by Ministry of MSME, the bidder shall be relaxed from the eligibility criteria of "Experience Criteria" as defined above subject to meeting of quality and technical specifications.
clauses.summary: MSE bidders are relaxed from the experience criterion subject to meeting quality and technical specifications.

clauses.quote: If the bidder itself is MSE OEM of the offered products, it would be relaxed from the "OEM Average Turnover" criteria also subject to meeting of quality and technical specifications.
clauses.summary: An MSE bidder that is itself the OEM is also relaxed from the OEM turnover criterion.

clauses.quote: If the bidder is a Micro or Small Enterprise (MSE) as per latest orders issued by Ministry of MSME, the bidder shall be relaxed from the eligibility criteria of "Bidder Turnover" as defined above subject to meeting of quality and technical specifications.
clauses.summary: MSE bidders are relaxed from the bidder turnover criterion subject to meeting quality and technical specifications.

clauses.quote: If the bidder is a DPIIT registered Startup, the bidder shall be relaxed from eligibility criteria of "Experience Criteria" as defined above subject to their meeting of quality and technical specifications.
clauses.summary: DPIIT-registered startups are relaxed from the experience criterion subject to meeting quality and technical specifications.

clauses.quote: If the bidder is a DPIIT registered Startup, the bidder shall be relaxed from eligibility criteria of "Bidder Turnover" as defined above subject to their meeting of quality and technical specifications.
clauses.summary: DPIIT-registered startups are relaxed from the bidder turnover criterion subject to meeting quality and technical specifications.

clauses.quote: The minimum average annual financial turnover of the bidder during the last three financial years, ending on 31st March of the previous financial year, should be as indicated in the bid document.
clauses.summary: Bidder turnover is averaged over the last three financial years and validated from GeM data.

clauses.heading: 6. Experience Criteria
clauses.quote: should have regularly, manufactured and supplied same or similar Category Products to any Central / State Govt Organization / PSU for number of Financial years as indicated above in the bid document before the bid opening date.
clauses.summary: The bidder or its OEM must have supplied similar products to government organisations or PSUs for the indicated number of financial years.

clauses.heading: 6. Experience Criteria
clauses.quote: Copies of relevant contracts and delivery acceptance certificates like CRAC to be submitted along with bid in support of having supplied some quantity during each of the Financial year.
clauses.summary: Contracts and delivery acceptance certificates must be submitted as proof of supplies in each financial year.

clauses.heading: 7. OEM Turn Over Criteria
clauses.quote: Documentary evidence in the form of certified Audited Balance Sheets of relevant periods or a certificate from the Chartered Accountant / Cost Accountant indicating the turnover details for the relevant period shall be uploaded with the bid.
clauses.summary: Audited balance sheets or a CA/cost accountant certificate must be uploaded to prove OEM turnover.
